entities.summary: Zaki Khan Zand was an Iranian military commander and contender for the throne. A member of the Zand dynasty of Iran, Zaki Khan, though he never became the ruler of Iran, managed to exert power over the country during the three months between the death of his half-brother Karim Khan Zand, on 2 March 1779, and his own brutal death.
